address: GF, Regent, 18 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The iconic Regent Hong Kong has reopened with several new F&B outlets. One of them is The Steak House commanding sweeping harbour views through its tall windows. As its name suggests, the menu revolves around steak – from Italy, Spain, Korea, Japan, Australia, and the U.S. The Moroccan chef ages his own beef - ask the servers. Season your favourite cuts with rock salt, charcoal salt, yuzu salt or the array of sauces and mustards on offer....
